notes.title: Coming Soon on Kickstarter – Follow to Get Notified!
notes.notes:
RMF’s Ragdoll Physics Experiments is gearing up for Kickstarter and you can help right now.

We’ve just launched our Kickstarter pre-launch page, and if you’re even mildly entertained by ragdolls getting obliterated in the name of “science,” then we need you to do one simple thing:

👉 Click “Notify Me on Launch” here: 
🔗 http://bit.ly/RPE-KickStarter

This tiny action makes a huge difference. The more people who click it, the more visibility we get when the campaign begins. This in turn means more absurd machines, more flying limbs, and more upgrades that probably shouldn’t exist.

It’s free. Takes two seconds. And it helps us make the weirdest physics sandbox possible.

Also, if you want to catch up with the development progress you'll find the devlop here:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3B_9IwypJZA&list=PLJY_MWUWiOg-1Z9lsd-K4Xh_0j0SjKFOn

We can't wait for you to be a part of this.
Giraffe Head Studios 🦒
